The text is truncated behind a paywall.

d4eeb21e1531c151f318541d048c1b980fa857a8.summary: Microsoft, as reported by The Record in January 2023, said nation-state groups from China, Iran, North Korea and Turkey were abusing the Log4Shell vulnerability to reach targeted networks. Named actors were PHOSPHORUS (Iran, deploying ransomware) and HAFNIUM (China, attacking virtualization infrastructure). Microsoft also saw initial access brokers selling footholds to ransomware gangs. Khonsari, a low-effort ransomware that tried to frame a person of Iranian descent, was spotted using the exploit. Over 60 exploit variants were observed, linked to DDoS botnets, crypto-mining and commodity…

d4c3fb7ebf839c2694a88d5afaa44da3caf3552b.summary: Joint advisory from ASD's ACSC, CISA, NSA, FBI and other partner agencies on APT40, a PRC state-sponsored group the authoring agencies assess conducts operations for the Ministry of State Security. It presents two anonymized case studies of 2022 intrusions into organisations, involving public-facing application exploitation, web shells, compromised credentials, Kerberoasting, lateral movement and credential capture from a remote access appliance. It lists CVEs (Log4J, Atlassian Confluence, Microsoft Exchange) the group exploits quickly after disclosure, notes its use of compromised SOHO…
